bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract metadata records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks in SQLite and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using pandas and Matplotlib.

As an individual contribution to a supervised course project, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and frequency-count steps on public programming question samples, then inspected frequent terms with guidance using the provided topic-coding guide.

For the supervised project, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks in SQLite and used pandas and Matplotlib to visualize group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.

Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to public company report samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
